feeding_claim.verbatim: All our beef and lamb is 100% grass-fed and finished: no grains, no GMOs, no hormones, no antibiotics.

pickup_locations: Cliff's Country Market, 217 Blaine St, Caldwell, ID 83605, Tuesdays from 12:00 PM
Wednesday meetup in Meridian, ID (time and place emailed with the order)

resold_note: Also sells bison, wild-caught seafood, eggs and honey that the site does not say the family raises, and says some animals come from partner family farms.
notes: The lead had this as Idaho, but the homepage says the family raises its animals on open pasture in Jordan Valley, Oregon, just over the Idaho border, so it is listed as OR. The business sells mainly into the Boise and Treasure Valley area (the FAQ also mentions Idaho pastures). Checked the homepage, our story, store, 100% grassfed protocol, FAQ, delivery, pickup and shipping pages. Beef and lamb are described as 100% grass-fed and finished; the FAQ says pigs and chickens are raised on pasture with non-GMO grain. Delivery is free across the Treasure Valley on orders of $199 or more (the meta text says $175) with a $15 fee below that. Pickup is at Cliff's Country Market in Caldwell and a Meridian meetup. Ships across the US except Alaska and Hawaii (the shipping page also excludes Puerto Rico). The FAQ lists quarter, half and whole beef, half and whole pork, and half and whole lamb shares.
